about_item: This version is for use on tub spout only. If you want to attach to showerhead, please purchase our shower cleaning thing. This is for pet bathing and tub rinsing, not shower rinsing. Easy to use and instantly turns any faucet into a swift rinsing station

PERFECT FIT: The Rinseroo Tub Version instantly attaches to your bathroom faucet attachment (up to 3" in diameter). Our tub faucet sprayer attachment has a portable design and moves from tub to tub with ease!

VERSATILE DESIGN: Not just for the bathroom, our dog washing hose attachment is a game changer. Add a garden hose to extend its reach and turn your faucet into a dog shower head, a plant rinser, and more.

NO TOOLS, NO STRESS: Skip the hassle of complicated setups. This lightweight faucet sprayer attachment slips on in seconds and coils up for neat storage, making it the go-to for a quick dog shower or tub clean-up.

THERE ARE SO MANY THINGS IT CAN DO: Transform your bathtub faucet adapter into a powerful baby shower attachment, give your pet a dog bath, fill a portable washing machine, and more. This tub faucet attachment simplifies so many of our least favorite chores.

summary.text: Customers find the bathtub faucet sprayer attachment works well on tub faucets and makes dog baths easier. The product receives mixed feedback regarding its fit, with some saying it slips right onto the faucet while others report it doesn't stay attached. Moreover, durability is a concern as the hose cracks quickly with minimal use, and there are issues with leakage, with some customers reporting no leakage while others say it leaks everywhere. Additionally, customers disagree on the product's value for money, with some considering it worth the price while others find it overpriced.

authors_reviews.title: Great product
authors_reviews.text: Very well made tool. If you follow the instructions, this tool works exactly as described. It is flexible enough to fit around and connect to a bathtub spout (and the pin you pull to turn to direct water to the shower head if you have one) and it comes with a reusable zip tie to make sure it’s snug and doesn’t slip off. Easy to slip on and doesn’t make any weird sounds.
authors_reviews.author: Alex B.

authors_reviews.title: Great product for shower cleaning
authors_reviews.text: If I could select 10 stars I would. Amazing product bought it to be able to clean my shower I have a rain shower head so no wand to rinse the shower after cleaning. It stayed on the faucet no issues. Since it is gravity fed when you hold it up the rubber expands with the water then I used the pressure to rinse the shower wall higher up by splashing the water it worked great. I've been using a cup to splash water down the shower walls to rinse which resulted in my taking a shower from the splashing water. Key feature is the zip tie provided is removable, genius. A well thought out product that works as described
authors_reviews.author: P. Dunn

authors_reviews.title: OK for rinsing but limited utility
authors_reviews.text: This would work OK for rinsing a dog or a child. But, it's not as quick to install/remove as you might think: just stretching the connector over the faucet doesn't do it; to keep it in place, you have to first apply reusable tape and then add a zip tie to hold the connector. The unit doesn't work above about waist height (connector blows up like a balloon and little water comes out), and the sprayer head doesn't generate much pressure (at any height), so this is useless for hosing down shower walls on cleaning day. The hose is also too short to reach the rear wall. The price is far too high for this limited functionality. I can't recommend this product.
authors_reviews.author: Jon

authors_reviews.title: Game changer. Great product!
authors_reviews.text: My Bulldog Meatloaf loves baths. Like really loves them. Whenever he hears the water spout in the tub he runs over and tries to get into the tub.Previously I would fill the tub and use a water bowl to get him wet and then to rinse off the shampoo. This method was time consuming and wasn’t that great at getting all of the shampoo off his coat.Using the Rinseroo, I am able to wet him down and most importantly rinse off all of the shampoo.The trick to using it is to not turn on the faucet too much otherwise the coupling swells up and shoots out the back or falls off the spout. With the right water pressure the coupling stays put and gives you adequate water pressure to soak and rinse. Cut my time more than half while doing a much more effective job
authors_reviews.author: Demoe

authors_reviews.title: Good product, a bit expensive though
authors_reviews.text: Worked pretty well. I like how this works. It used to be substantially less expensive. Other than that, I am happy with the product. Water flow was good, and I had no leaks at the tub faucet. I used tight rubber bands to secure the rubber sleeve as well as the provided reusable zip tie.
authors_reviews.author: AMZN Cust

authors_reviews.title: very handy to have around the house
authors_reviews.text: I've had this for a good while now, and I can confidently say that it has withstood multiple uses and is still going strong. It's a major game-changer for dog bath time that I don't have to fill up a cup anymore, and I get more confidence in knowing I got my pup's coat rinsed well. Much easier to rinse her belly, too. I've also made good use of this for some shaving when I opt for sitting on the side of the tub instead of taking a full shower, and for helping to clean the shower and bath tub by re-directing the water where I need it. Super easy to take on and off the faucet, I just make sure I hang it to dry when I'm done. You don't get a TON of water pressure, but you do get plenty for the above mentioned tasks. I also like that's clear tubing, so I can tell that it's clean.
authors_reviews.author: Joy

authors_reviews.title: Buy it!
authors_reviews.text: We have a garden tub, and this made giving my dog a bath so much easier. The rinsing and getting underneath his belly. It seems like a simple idea, but this is really done well. Easy to slip on the tub spout. Snug fit, no leaks! I can’t speak to how long it will last, but it is still a great value compared to paying for grooming.
authors_reviews.author: PSLS

authors_reviews.title: Quick & Convenient Bathtub Sprayer Attachment
authors_reviews.text: This faucet sprayer attachment is incredibly easy to use—just slip it onto the bathtub faucet and you're ready to go. It creates a strong, steady stream of water and is perfect for rinsing the tub, washing pets, or other household tasks. I love that it requires no tools or complicated installation. The material feels durable, and it stores away easily when not in use. A simple but very useful solution for adding a temporary sprayer to a bathtub faucet.
authors_reviews.author: Elizabeth R

other_countries_reviews.title: Piece of Junk Exploded Like a Water Balloon!
other_countries_reviews.text: I used the Rinsearoo to bathe my first dog and despite the hose looking and feeling flimsy and cheap for something over $50, it worked fine. There was a small leak at the faucet, nothing major - just a light dribble - so nothing concerning. Overall, I was initially satisfied.However, when I went to bathe my second dog, things went very wrong. I hadn’t removed or adjusted anything; it was still attached exactly the same way as before. But this time, the rubber piece that fits over the faucet suddenly filled with water and expanded like a balloon. Before I could even turn the water off, it burst and sent water everywhere, completely soaking me and the bathroom.I have no idea why this happened. It worked perfectly for the first bath, there was nothing blocking the hose, and I didn’t change a thing. The sudden swelling and explosion were totally unexpected and pretty alarming. As you can see in the picture, the hose part blew right off the rubber part that attaches to the faucet. Piece of junk.
other_countries_reviews.author: Real Person Real Reviews
